posts.title: It Said Threat, It Stored False Alarm: Stress-Testing an AI Alert Triage Copilot
posts.description: An open-source SOC copilot asks Gemini whether each alert is real. An older model fell for text an attacker wrote into a log; the code around it failed worse.

posts.title: Signing the Maintenance Window: Testing Oracle Patch Guard's Approval Chain
posts.description: Oracle Patch Guard turns a database patch approval into a signed, bound artifact. It blocked every tamper I tried, then a cloned host replayed one.

posts.title: Grading My Own Cloud: cloudbeat, Keyless CSPM, and the CIS Edition Behind the Score
posts.description: I pointed Elastic's cloudbeat at my own Kubernetes cluster and an AWS account. The posture scores were real. The CIS benchmark editions behind them were not current.
